# Casper Network for AI agents

> The starting point for AI agents and LLM tools working with the Casper Network: documentation indexes, guides to what has changed since the 2.0 documentation, and the MCP servers, agent skills, plugins, APIs and SDKs built for agents, from across the ecosystem.

Each link fetches markdown or plain text. The URL after the colon is where a person reads it, followed by a short description.
Maintained at https://github.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms and generated from its catalog.json.

## Start here

- [Casper AI directory](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms/main/directory.md): https://github.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms/blob/main/directory.md - Every capability listed here, with its endpoint, authentication, pricing, networks and source.

## Documentation indexes

- [Casper Network documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms/main/casper-docs/llms.txt): https://github.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms/blob/main/casper-docs/llms.txt - 221 pages. The official Casper Network documentation (docs.casper.network), indexed from its source repository casper-network/docs-redux.
- [Casper node, sidecar and command-line client](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms/main/casper-node-tools/llms.txt): https://github.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms/blob/main/casper-node-tools/llms.txt - 29 pages. Operator and integrator references for the Casper node software.
- [Casper SDKs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms/main/casper-sdks/llms.txt): https://github.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms/blob/main/casper-sdks/llms.txt - 183 pages. Developer documentation for the Casper SDKs.
- [Casper token and NFT standard implementations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms/main/casper-standards/llms.txt): https://github.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms/blob/main/casper-standards/llms.txt - 28 pages. Reference implementations and guides for Casper's token standards from the casper-ecosystem organization.
- [Casper Enhancement Proposals (CEPs)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms/main/casper-ceps/llms.txt): https://github.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms/blob/main/casper-ceps/llms.txt - 45 pages. The Casper Enhancement Proposals from casper-network/ceps.
- [Odra smart-contract framework](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms/main/odra/llms.txt): https://github.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms/blob/main/odra/llms.txt - 53 pages. Documentation for Odra, the Rust framework for writing, testing and deploying Casper smart contracts.
- [x402 payments on Casper](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms/main/casper-x402/llms.txt): https://github.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms/blob/main/casper-x402/llms.txt - 21 pages. The x402 pay-per-request protocol on Casper.
- [Casper agent skills and MCP servers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms/main/casper-agent-tools/llms.txt): https://github.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms/blob/main/casper-agent-tools/llms.txt - 30 pages. Agent skills, MCP servers and plugins for Casper.

## MCP servers

- [casper-mcp](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/msanlisavas/casper-mcp/main/README.md): https://github.com/msanlisavas/casper-mcp - Self-hosted MCP server for Casper on-chain data through CSPR.cloud: accounts, blocks, deploys, validators, contracts, tokens and NFTs, with optional locally signed write tools in stdio mode.
